name: Shrine-Wise
description:
Your time among the forested peaks around Upham has taught you to respect even the most forgotten-looking shrines.

Whenever you encounter a shrine, temple or other place of worship, you can always determine what would be an appropriate offering to make to the spirit or deity of that shrine.

Once per day, you may make such an offering. Roll a fate die. The result, halved, is the number of +1d bonuses you may hold in reserve. For the next day, whenever you or a creature you can see would make a skill check, you may spend a reaction to apply any number of these +1d bonuses to the roll. After one day has passed, any remaining bonuses are forfeited.

Describe your offering.
successes:
🌞: You gain 6 +1d bonuses and they aren't forfeited after one day.

💀: Your offering was not well-received. All your skill checks are ill-favored for next day.
